question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: different_quantity

items.text: Merrill reports growth in client balances, AUM flows, and new households, and is recruiting experienced advisors and training new ones through its Advisor Development Program to grow the sales force.
items.quote: we're picking up the recruiting of experienced advisors. That isn't an enormous part of our strategy, but it's a training program so that we're training people in wealth management, Bank of America, and Merrill, and that's ultimately what we believe we can just keep driving in order to improve the net new flows.

items.text: Merrill maintains an industry-leading advisor force with >15K wealth advisors and emphasizes having the best advisors to deliver client outcomes, per its investor-day deck.
items.quote: having the best advisors enables us to deliver exceptional client outcomes

items.text: Merrill has a next-gen focus, with the most advisors named to Forbes' 2025 Top Next-Generation Wealth Advisors Best-in-State list (446 advisors), indicating preparation for succession through younger advisors.
items.quote: Recognized more than any other firm, Merrill had 446 advisors named to the 2025 Forbes "Top Next-Generation Wealth Advisors Best-in-State" list

items.text: Merrill serves multi-generational families and high-net-worth clients through its private wealth management business, per descriptions of advisors serving ultra-high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: specializes in serving high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients

items.text: Merrill launched Tax Efficient Transition Service and Dollar Cost Averaging Service in 2026 to help clients simplify asset transitions and systematic cash investing, which could support wealth transfer.
items.quote: Merrill today announced the launch of Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET) and Dollar Cost Averaging Service (DCA), new services that combine automation with professional portfolio oversight to help clients simplify asset transitions and cash deployment

items.text: Merrill advisors serve multi-generational families, per a description of the Economos Group practice founded in 1994 that built through 2000-2025 before departing to independence.
items.quote: His father founded The Economos Group at Merrill Lynch in 1994; Nick joined in 2000 and spent the following quarter century building within that structure

items.text: Merrill reports 54K $10MM+ households and 750K $500K+ households, indicating a large base of wealthy clients relevant to wealth transfer.

cells.differs_because: The sub-question asks which firm appears most prepared for the generational wealth transfer and why; the passages do not directly state Merrill's preparation for generational wealth transfer, but provide related evidence (advisor recruiting/training, next-gen advisor rankings, multi-generational family service, portfolio transition services, and wealthy household counts) that could inform such an assessment.
cells.reason: No passage directly addresses Merrill's preparedness for the generational wealth transfer; passages offer related indicators rather than an explicit statement on the asked topic.
